rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose name for the fish, and in food contexts for a salmon dish.

example.english: I want to eat salmon tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 saam1 man4 jyu4

rows.note: Use this specifically when naming the pale pinkish-orange colour rather than the fish or a dish.

example.english: The salmon colour of this dress really suits you.
example.traditional: 呢條裙嘅三文魚色好襯你。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 ge3 saam1 man4 jyu4 sik1 hou2 can3 nei5
